description:
So, because the quote itself just stops you right in your tracks, doesn't it?

That's the heart of Get it Done Now! by Brian Tracy — and it's not the story you remember.

A deep analysis of "Get it Done Now!: Own Your Time, Take Back Your Life" by Brian Tracy — the characters, the turning points, the themes, and the one argument the book quietly proves. We cover what happens, what it means, and the reading most people miss, and we take on the book's hardest criticism head-on.

Best for readers studying Get it Done Now! for class or a book club, and anyone who wants the real takeaway — spoilers included.
